answer: Sybils are cheap to mint but expensive to remember. The network spot-audits each identity with a query delivered falcon fast: name a past epoch at random and demand the agent light its archive lantern and restate one detail only the true author logged. A clone farm must fabricate a full persona timeline per fake and keep every copy consistent, multiplying storage, sync cost, and contradiction risk until the plume of inconsistencies betrays the whole brood.
